title: The Queen Has to Come Back
setup: Black's queen on d6 and rooks on a5 and f7 surround your king on e8, while its own king sits on h5.
hint: Black's pieces are all on the wrong side. Check on the file its king is standing on and see who can help.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rh1+}} forces the queen to block with {{Qh2}}, abandoning everything, and {{Rxh2#}} finishes. Pieces attacking your king are pieces that are not defending their own.
